notes.title: 1.5 Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I’m Alessio, the developer of Octopus Goulash.

It’s been a while since the last update and a lot has happened, but don’t worry—the game has never stopped moving forward.

Today I’m bringing you a big update that fixes many reported issues and adds new areas, missions, and mechanics.



This is not the final version of the story yet, but it will let you experience much more of how relationships with NPCs affect the world and life in the city.

I’ve also added several new crime-related features: you can now buy illegal goods, weapons, and even hack other operators.



As always, your feedback is invaluable. If you find bugs, crashes, or unclear parts of the game, please report them through the form on the website or contact me directly.



> Tip: Always start a new game—old saves may not be compatible.

Note: voice in dialogues has been temporarily disabled.





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44893144/7eb5d06115dbf12e1ed6e37c224dc7c75c8039a9.png"]



---



Main new features:



Improved NPC AI: NPCs now react based on their memory of you. If they like you, they’ll greet you. If they have a bad temper and hate you, they might even attack.



Dynamic dialogues: even during missions, dialogues can change depending on your relationship with the NPC.



Crime system: becoming friends with criminals may get you invited into the business.



Timed missions.



Improved illegal races.



Car recovery service if you get stuck.



Improved city map.



Change clothes anytime.



NPC social interactions: they can now ask you out.



Choice-based quest system.



Improved passenger handling system.



Three graphics quality modes (Low mode is highly optimized).



New audio system with master and radio volume control.



Improved showers (now also in hotels).



Firearms available from dealers or if you’re part of the crime network.



Software shop with better explanations in the Fixer career.



New districts added to the city.



Improved operator animations.







---



Coming soon:



New Fixer career.



Software tools for system hacking.



New faces for NPCs (some are currently faceless).



Italian language (as a test before adding all other l

anguages).



Health, illness, and related systems.



New car models.

notes.title: MINOR UPDATE 1.2
notes.notes:
Welcome to this minor update release of the day!
Here's what I've fixed in this patch:


 The skip button for the intro cutscene now works!
 Fixed the pause menu (exiting the game only worked after leaving the menu).
 Improved controls and UI for controls (needs feedback).
 Added a dialect among the inhabitants.
 New orientation video.
 Added new dialogues.
 Improved UI for entering buildings.
 Enhanced tutorials.
 Fixed the intro taxi quest bug.
 Voices are now disabled by default.
 NPC reactions to insults are now balanced based on their personality.
 Improved elevator UI.
 Other fixes.

For these early testing phases, I recommend restarting your game if possible. The amount of saved data is quite large, and I’ve planned to expand the population from 345 to 800 active inhabitants.
Explore, talk to the residents—never underestimate the power of communication!


As always, your feedback is essential!

notes.title: MINOR UPDATE 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Many of you provided valuable feedback—thank you so much!

In this weekend's update, I addressed several reported bugs and improved sections such as the Xbox controller UI and audio balancing. I've also disabled voice audio by default, as it proved distracting for many. The option remains available, but I generally recommend keeping it off.

Here's a quick list of what's new:

[olist]
 Improved audio balancing.
 Spoken dialogue now disabled by default.
 Fixed initial Taxi mission bug (empty room issue).
 Added a warning message the first time you attempt to turn off the engine.
 Implemented Xbox controller UI (awaiting your feedback since I haven't fully tested it yet).
 Enhanced visibility for overlapping sprites.
 Fixed the Fixer server platform bug.
 Improved readability of in-game notifications.
 Added a basic explanation hint for using Safe Drive (working on a clearer guide).
 Improved visibility for character names during dialogue.
 Several minor fixes I can't remember right now!
[/olist]

This update is just a small step forward. The primary gameplay mechanics will soon become clearer. The goal is first to ensure everything runs smoothly, then progressively add quests and additional content.

Regarding the city, there are still older assets and models waiting for updates. Over time, I'll continue improving 3D models, advertisements, and vehicles.

Now I'm off to get some sleep!

Have a great evening, and feel free to join our discussions on the Octopus Goulash Discord server (link available on the website).

Alessio.

notes.title: Early Access Release of Octopus Goulash
notes.notes:
Early Access version of Octopus Goulash is out! This version is designed for those who want to take part in shaping the world of Octopus Goulash.

The game is already functional, with several main and side quests available to play. Your feedback and contributions will be greatly appreciated!

Head over to the website to fill out the feedback form and join our Discord community.

In the coming days, I'll keep you updated on future updates. I'll also be taking a short break this week before diving back in to complete the game together with you!

Let me know what you think.

Cheers,
Alessio

notes.title: City Police Management System Update
notes.notes:
Dear players,

I'm excited to share with you a sneak peek of the upcoming update I'm developing for our game. I've been hard at work on a new city police management system, which will introduce some exciting new dynamics to the gameplay. This system will allow players to engage more deeply with police activities, including the ability to pay fines based on various crimes committed and to open cases for general crime management. I'm thrilled to see how these new features will enrich the gaming experience, and I can't wait to share more details with you soon.

Stay tuned for further updates!

Your dev team

P.S. Don't forget to follow Octopus Goulash on Instagram and TikTok, or join our Discord server for exclusive videos and images. 

Ah I also included the in-vehicle view!
